title: Small Group Wine Tasting: Explore Diverse Wines and PNW Cuisine
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Immerse yourself in a unique wine tasting experience near Pike Place Market, where you'll sample up to five exceptional wines from diverse wineries. This engaging 90-minute session features expertly prepared cuisine bites, allowing you to savor local flavors alongside your wine selections. Knowledgeable staff will guide you through each wine, sharing fascinating stories about the winemakers and their craft, creating a community atmosphere that feels like home. Perfect for wine enthusiasts and casual drinkers alike, this small group setting ensures a personalized experience.

- Taste up to five wines from various local winemakers
- Enjoy three bites of fresh Pacific Northwest cuisine
- Engage with knowledgeable staff for curated selections and stories
- 90-minute small group experience near Pike Place Market
